integrity: The argument is analytic and definition-level. The arbitrary-gap family is proved uniformly in every finite dimension \(N\ge2\); no numerical experiment, external certificate, or independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The result assumes a nonzero closed-range operator \(K\). It gives a universal inequality and two equality classes but not a complete characterization of equality, and it does not reassess downstream statements that may depend on the disputed unrestricted identity.
title: Projection can overcount \(K\)-frame excess by an arbitrarily large amount
